text:
jyoti: Quick proposal — want to run a fastpath canary for the new quantized m3-70b build. Goal: measure speculative decoding speedups vs baseline and check top-line quality regression risk.

anna: +1. do you mean speculative sampling glue we've been sketching? what's the traffic shape for the canary?

jyoti: Yep. Two arms: 1) speculative decoding enabled (our current early-exit + branch sampling) on quantized model, 2) speculative disabled (pure greedy/temperature as control). Small internal canary: 5 p95 requests/sec steady per replica, 1000 prompts sampled from eval harness (conversational + long-context docs).

miguel: Good. Need to pin quantization bits and kernel config. Which quant profile?

jyoti: Using q4_0 hybrid profile we used in last run (per-token kernel = fused-gemv-v2). Will note exact quant config in the canary metadata. Also doing a second pass with q3fast for throughput-only check.

Anna: Can we run with deterministic seeds for samplers? Want repeatability for quality diffs. Also split prompts by prompt-length buckets (<=128, 129-512, >512).

jyoti: Yep — deterministic RNG for sampling and fixed prompt buckets. Quality metrics: LM score, exact-match on our QA subset, and diversity (distinct-1/2). Also human eval spot checks for hallucinations.

tom: CI bot can kick off the harness if you drop the config. FYI we have a preflight job that checks perf regressions against baseline.

ci-bot: Received canary config. Queued jobs: perf-smoke, quality-smoke, rollout-check. ETA ~45m.

miguel: Two operational questions: 1) If speculative causes token-level stall (KV churn) do we fallback to non-speculative mid-response? 2) How will we surface these stalls in Console?

jyoti: For (1) plan is soft-fallback: if speculative path latency exceeds 2x median, abort speculative and replay on conservative path for remainder of response. We'll log an event per request. For (2) we'll push a temporary per-route dashboard showing speculative failure rate, mean extra latency, and tokens shaved.

anna: Please capture raw logits for 100 prompts in both arms — that'll help us analyze bias introduced by quant+speculative. Keep them encrypted for privacy.

jyoti: Will do. Also adding a small eval script snippet: ```python
# run harness snippet
run_eval(model='m3-70b-q4', speculative=True, seed=42, prompts=prompts_bucket)
run_eval(model='m3-70b-q4', speculative=False, seed=42, prompts=prompts_bucket)
```

miguel: If we see >1% drop in QA EM on top-tier prompts we pause rollout. Anything else?

jyoti: Additions: compare token cost delta, p95 latency delta, and per-prompt quality regression table. We'll also do a short human fraud-check for safety sensitive prompts.

tom: Let us know if the canary needs dedicated GPUs. If throughput tests spike, we'll isolate on a small dedicated pool.

jyoti: Thanks — I'll upload the config to the canary folder and ping when ci-bot completes. Expected first results in ~1h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ci-bot: perf-smoke passed. quality-smoke queued (0/1).

anna: Nice. once we have output, we should run the acceptance diff script (diff_quality.py) and post a short summary here.

jyoti: Will do. planning to include a one-slide summary with a short verdict: go/no-go for enabling speculative by default on this quant profile.

miguel: Thanks — this covers both ops and eval concerns. If we hit edge regressions, we can try reducing speculative beam count from 3->1 as a mitigation.

jyoti: Noted. cc @tom for ops watch.
